english: Put ID cards, land papers and phone numbers in a sealed plastic bag.
translation: Weka vitambulisho, hati za ardhi na namba za simu katika mfuko wa plastiki uliofungwa vizuri.

english: Papers are the hardest thing to replace after a flood.
translation: Hati ni vitu vigumu zaidi kupata tena baada ya mafuriko.

english: Agree with your household on a high place to go and a way to get there.
translation: Kubaliana na watu wa nyumbani kuhusu sehemu ya juu mtakapokwenda na njia ya kufika huko.

english: Deciding in the dark, in the rain, is when people get hurt.
translation: Watu hujeruhiwa wanapoamua gizani, mvua ikinyesha.

english: Store clean drinking water in closed containers, enough for three days.
translation: Weka maji safi ya kunywa katika vyombo vilivyofungwa, ya kutosha siku tatu.

english: Floods pollute wells and taps first.
translation: Mafuriko huchafua visima na mabomba kwanza.

english: Clear drains, gutters and channels near your home now.
translation: Safisha mifereji, mitaro na njia za maji karibu na nyumba yako sasa.

english: Blocked drains turn heavy rain into a flood in your yard.
translation: Mifereji iliyofungwa hufanya mvua kubwa iwe mafuriko katika uwanja wako.

english: Move food, seeds, fertiliser and valuables off the floor.
translation: Weka chakula, mbegu, mbolea na vitu vya thamani juu, mbali na sakafu.

english: Even shallow water ruins stored food and seed.
translation: Hata maji kidogo huharibu chakula na mbegu zilizowekwa akiba.

english: Plan where animals can go on higher ground.
translation: Panga sehemu ya juu ambapo wanyama wanaweza kwenda.

english: Livestock losses are often the biggest cost of a flood.
translation: Kufa kwa mifugo mara nyingi ni hasara kubwa zaidi ya mafuriko.

english: Find out how your local warnings are given: radio, SMS, loudspeaker or a neighbour.
translation: Tafuta jinsi tahadhari za eneo lako zinatolewa: redio, SMS, kipaza sauti au jirani.

english: The official warning is the signal to act.
translation: Tahadhari rasmi ni ishara ya kuchukua hatua.

english: Keep a week of any daily medicines in the emergency bag.
translation: Weka dawa za kila siku za wiki moja katika mfuko wa dharura.

english: Clinics may be cut off for days.
translation: Kliniki zinaweza kutofikika kwa siku kadhaa.

english: Learn where the river reached in the last big flood and stay above that line.
translation: Jua mto ulifika wapi katika mafuriko makubwa ya mwisho, na kaa juu ya kiwango hicho.

english: Past high-water marks are the best local guide.
translation: Alama za maji ya juu za zamani ni mwongozo bora wa eneo lako.

english: Never cross a flooded road or dry riverbed during heavy rain.
translation: Usivuke barabara iliyojaa maji au mkondo mkavu wa mto wakati wa mvua kubwa.

english: Most flash-flood deaths happen in vehicles and river crossings.
translation: Vifo vingi vya mafuriko ya ghafla hutokea ndani ya magari na kwenye vivuko vya mito.

english: Watch for new cracks, tilting trees or springs on slopes above your home.
translation: Angalia nyufa mpya, miti inayoinama au chemchemi kwenye miteremko iliyo juu ya nyumba yako.

english: Slopes give warning signs before they fail.
translation: Miteremko hutoa ishara za tahadhari kabla ya kuporomoka.

english: If you live below a steep slope, arrange a safer place to sleep during heavy rain.
translation: Kama unaishi chini ya mteremko mkali, panga sehemu salama zaidi ya kulala wakati wa mvua kubwa.

english: Landslides mostly strike at night after days of rain.
translation: Maporomoko ya udongo mara nyingi hutokea usiku baada ya siku kadhaa za mvua.

english: Fix leaks and add water storage: tanks, drums, or a covered pit.
translation: Rekebisha uvujaji na ongeza hifadhi ya maji: matangi, madumu, au shimo lenye kifuniko.

english: Every litre saved now is a litre you do not have to carry later.
translation: Kila lita unayohifadhi sasa ni lita ambayo hutalazimika kuibeba baadaye.

english: Ask your extension officer about early-maturing or drought-tolerant seed.
translation: Muulize afisa ugani kuhusu mbegu zinazokomaa haraka au zinazovumilia ukame.

english: Short-season crops can finish before the rains stop.
translation: Mazao ya msimu mfupi yanaweza kukomaa kabla mvua hazijaisha.

english: Plant staggered: some early, some at normal time, not all at once.
translation: Panda kwa awamu: baadhi mapema, baadhi kwa wakati wa kawaida, sio yote kwa mara moja.

english: Spreads the risk of a false start to the rains.
translation: Hii inagawanya hatari ikiwa mvua zinaanza kisha zinasimama.

english: Cut and store extra fodder; consider selling weak animals early.
translation: Vuna na hifadhi malisho ya ziada; fikiria kuuza mifugo dhaifu mapema.

english: Prices fall once everyone sells at the same time.
translation: Bei hushuka wakati watu wote wanauza kwa wakati mmoja.

english: Buy staple food a little at a time now while prices are normal.
translation: Nunua chakula kikuu kidogo kidogo sasa, wakati bei ni ya kawaida.

english: Food prices rise fastest when harvests fail.
translation: Bei za chakula hupanda haraka zaidi mavuno yanapoharibika.

english: Agree with neighbours how a shared well or tank will be rationed.
translation: Patana na majirani jinsi kisima au tangi la pamoja litatumika kwa mgao.

english: Agreed rules prevent conflict when water gets short.
translation: Makubaliano yaliyowekwa huzuia migogoro maji yanapopungua.

english: Store water and plan irrigation if you are in the north or east.
translation: Hifadhi maji na panga umwagiliaji ikiwa unakaa kaskazini au mashariki.

english: El Niño summers are often dry there.
translation: Majira ya joto ya El Niño mara nyingi huwa makavu huko.

english: Reuse washing water for gardens and toilets.
translation: Tumia tena maji ya kufua kwa bustani na vyoo.

english: Cuts household water use by a third.
translation: Hii inapunguza matumizi ya maji ya nyumbani kwa theluthi moja.

english: Learn your city's water rationing schedule and fill containers on supply days.
translation: Jifunze ratiba ya mgao wa maji ya mji wako na jaza vyombo siku maji yanapotoka.

english: Cities ration during dry seasons; knowing the day avoids empty taps.
translation: Miji hutoa maji kwa mgao wakati wa kiangazi; kujua siku hukuepusha na mabomba matupu.

english: Clear dry grass and brush at least 10 metres around buildings.
translation: Safisha nyasi kavu na vichaka kwa umbali wa mita 10 au zaidi kuzunguka majengo.

english: A cleared strip stops most grass fires reaching a house.
translation: Eneo lililosafishwa huzuia mioto mingi ya nyasi kufikia nyumba.

english: Do not burn fields or rubbish on hot, windy days.
translation: Usichome mashamba au taka siku za joto na upepo.

english: Most large fires start as a controlled burn that escaped.
translation: Mioto mikubwa mingi huanza kama moto uliowashwa kwa makusudi ambao ulienea bila kudhibitiwa.

english: Make a leave-early plan and follow your fire service's danger ratings.
translation: Panga kuondoka mapema na fuata viwango vya hatari vinavyotolewa na idara ya zimamoto.

english: Leaving late is the most dangerous choice in a bushfire.
translation: Kuondoka kwa kuchelewa ni uamuzi wenye hatari kubwa zaidi wakati wa moto wa vichaka.

english: Prepare an evacuation bag and know two ways out of your area.
translation: Tayarisha mkoba wa kuhama na ujue njia mbili za kutoka eneo lako.

english: Wildfires can close the main road within minutes.
translation: Moto wa mwituni unaweza kufunga barabara kuu kwa dakika chache.

english: Keep masks for smoke days and a room that can be closed off.
translation: Weka barakoa kwa siku za moshi, na uwe na chumba kinachoweza kufungwa.

english: Smoke haze harms children and the elderly most.
translation: Moshi huwadhuru watoto na wazee zaidi.

english: Move hard work to early morning and late afternoon.
translation: Fanya kazi ngumu asubuhi mapema na jioni.

english: Heat illness peaks in the middle of the day.
translation: Magonjwa ya joto huwa mengi zaidi katikati ya siku.

english: Check daily on elderly neighbours and people living alone.
translation: Angalia kila siku majirani wazee na watu wanaoishi peke yao.

english: Most heat deaths happen quietly at home.
translation: Vifo vingi vinavyosababishwa na joto hutokea nyumbani bila mtu kujua.

english: Drink water often, before you feel thirsty.
translation: Kunywa maji mara nyingi, kabla ya kuhisi kiu.

english: Thirst comes late when the body is already short of water.
translation: Kiu huja kwa kuchelewa, wakati mwili tayari umepungukiwa maji.

english: Boil or treat drinking water when floods reach wells or pipes.
translation: Chemsha maji ya kunywa au weka dawa ya kusafisha maji, mafuriko yanapofika kwenye visima au mabomba.

english: Cholera and diarrhoea spread through flood water.
translation: Kipindupindu na kuharisha huenea kwa maji ya mafuriko.

english: Empty standing water around the home every few days and use nets.
translation: Mwaga maji yaliyosimama karibu na nyumba kila siku chache, na tumia vyandarua.

english: Mosquito diseases rise after heavy rain.
translation: Magonjwa yanayoenezwa na mbu huongezeka baada ya mvua kubwa.

english: Keep oral rehydration salts at home and know the nearest clinic.
translation: Weka nyumbani chumvi za kurudisha maji mwilini (ORS) na ujue kliniki iliyo karibu.

english: Fast rehydration saves lives in cholera outbreaks.
translation: Kurudisha maji mwilini haraka huokoa maisha wakati wa mlipuko wa kipindupindu.

english: Report sudden animal deaths or abortions to a vet, and avoid handling sick animals.
translation: Toa taarifa kwa daktari wa mifugo kuhusu vifo vya ghafla au mimba zinazoharibika, na usishike mifugo wagonjwa.

english: Rift Valley fever spreads to people from sick livestock after floods.
translation: Homa ya Bonde la Ufa huwaambukiza watu kutoka mifugo wagonjwa baada ya mafuriko.

english: Mulch fields to hold soil moisture.
translation: Tandaza matandazo shambani ili kuhifadhi unyevu wa udongo.

english: Mulch can keep soil moist for an extra week or two.
translation: Matandazo yanaweza kuhifadhi unyevu wa udongo kwa wiki moja au mbili zaidi.

english: Plant a mix of crops, including some that need less water.
translation: Panda mazao mchanganyiko, pamoja na yale yanayohitaji maji kidogo.

english: One failed crop hurts less when others survive.
translation: Kushindwa kwa zao moja kunaumiza kidogo ikiwa mazao mengine yanaendelea kukua.

english: Ask about crop insurance or a farmer group support scheme before planting.
translation: Uliza kuhusu bima ya mazao au mpango wa msaada wa kikundi cha wakulima kabla ya kupanda.

english: Most schemes close their sign-up before the season starts.
translation: Mipango mingi hufunga usajili kabla msimu kuanza.

english: Find out which local groups give food or cash support and how to register.
translation: Tafuta ni vikundi vipi vya hapa vinatoa chakula au msaada wa fedha, na jinsi ya kujiandikisha.

english: Registering early avoids queues when help arrives.
translation: Kujiandikisha mapema huepusha mistari mirefu msaada unapofika.

english: Prepare a hurricane kit: water, food, torch, radio, medicines, documents.
translation: Tayarisha vifaa vya kimbunga: maji, chakula, tochi, redio, dawa, hati muhimu.

english: Shops and power may be out for days after a storm.
translation: Maduka na umeme vinaweza kukosekana kwa siku kadhaa baada ya dhoruba.

english: Know your nearest shelter and how you will get there.
translation: Jua mahali pa hifadhi palipo karibu nawe na jinsi utakavyofika huko.

english: Shelters fill fast once a warning is issued.
translation: Sehemu za hifadhi hujaa haraka tahadhari inapotolewa.

english: Prepare a typhoon kit: water, food, torch, radio, medicines, documents.
translation: Tayarisha vifaa vya kimbunga: maji, chakula, tochi, redio, dawa, hati muhimu.

english: Shops and power may be out for days after a storm.
translation: Maduka na umeme vinaweza kukosekana kwa siku kadhaa baada ya dhoruba.

english: Fishers: agree a safe harbour plan and follow no-sail warnings.
translation: Wavuvi: patana kuhusu mpango wa bandari salama na fuata tahadhari za kutokwenda baharini.

english: Most typhoon deaths at sea are boats caught out.
translation: Vifo vingi vya kimbunga baharini ni vya watu wanaokutwa na kimbunga wakiwa kwenye boti.

english: Prepare a cyclone kit: water, food, torch, radio, medicines, documents.
translation: Tayarisha vifaa vya kimbunga: maji, chakula, tochi, redio, dawa, hati muhimu.

english: Shops and power may be out for days after a storm.
translation: Maduka na umeme vinaweza kukosekana kwa siku kadhaa baada ya dhoruba.

english: Tie down or repair loose roofing before the season.
translation: Funga vizuri au tengeneza paa lililolegea kabla ya msimu.

english: Loose roof sheets are the main cause of cyclone damage and injury.
translation: Mabati ya paa yaliyolegea ni chanzo kikuu cha uharibifu na majeraha wakati wa kimbunga.

english: Know your evacuation route and shelter before the cyclone season.
translation: Jua njia yako ya kuondoka na mahali pa hifadhi kabla ya msimu wa vimbunga.

english: Cyclones in the Mozambique Channel bring floods far inland.
translation: Vimbunga katika Mkondo wa Msumbiji huleta mafuriko hata mbali ndani ya nchi kavu.

english: Prepare for cyclones even if your island is rarely hit.
translation: Jiandae kwa vimbunga hata kama kisiwa chako hupigwa mara chache.

english: During El Niño, cyclones form and travel farther east than usual.
translation: Wakati wa El Niño, vimbunga huundwa na kusafiri mashariki zaidi kuliko kawaida.

english: Trim weak branches and secure loose items outdoors.
translation: Kata matawi dhaifu na funga vizuri vitu vya nje vinavyoweza kupeperushwa na upepo.

english: Falling branches cause most storm damage to homes.
translation: Matawi yanayoanguka husababisha uharibifu mkubwa wa nyumba wakati wa dhoruba.

english: Move valuables and sleeping areas away from the shoreline during king tides.
translation: Hamisha vitu vya thamani na sehemu za kulala mbali na ufuo wakati wa maji kujaa sana baharini.

english: Sea level is higher than normal on Pacific atolls during El Niño.
translation: Usawa wa bahari uko juu kuliko kawaida katika visiwa vya atoli vya Pasifiki wakati wa El Niño.

english: Store fresh water before the dry season; test wells for salt.
translation: Weka akiba ya maji safi kabla ya msimu wa kiangazi; pima maji ya visima kuona kama yana chumvi.

english: Low river flow lets sea water push into wells and canals.
translation: Mito ikipungua maji, maji ya bahari huingia katika visima na mifereji.

english: Cover seedlings at night and keep seed for replanting.
translation: Funika miche usiku na weka akiba ya mbegu kwa kupanda tena.

english: Highland frost during dry spells can kill a whole crop overnight.
translation: Barafu ya usiku katika nyanda za juu wakati wa vipindi vya ukame inaweza kuua mazao yote kwa usiku mmoja.

english: Expect lower rivers next summer; plan irrigation and water use early.
translation: Tarajia mito yenye maji kidogo majira ya joto yajayo; panga umwagiliaji na matumizi ya maji mapema.

english: Less winter snow means less water later in the year.
translation: Theluji kidogo majira ya baridi inamaanisha maji kidogo baadaye mwakani.

english: Keep extra food, heating fuel and medicines in case roads close.
translation: Weka akiba ya chakula, mafuta ya kupasha moto na dawa ikiwa barabara zitafungwa.

english: Heavy snow can cut off towns for days.
translation: Theluji nyingi inaweza kufunga njia za kufika mijini kwa siku kadhaa.

english: Check heating, insulation and warm clothing before winter.
translation: Kabla ya majira ya baridi, angalia vifaa vya kupasha joto, ziba mianya inayoingiza baridi nyumbani, na andaa nguo za joto.

english: Cold snaps hit older people and babies hardest.
translation: Vipindi vya baridi kali huwaathiri zaidi wazee na watoto wachanga.

english: Expect higher rivers in spring when heavy snow melts.
translation: Tarajia mito kujaa zaidi majira ya machipuko theluji nyingi inapoyeyuka.

english: A snowy winter often means spring floods.
translation: Majira ya baridi yenye theluji nyingi mara nyingi huleta mafuriko ya machipuko.

english: Watch for more pests and mould; a mild winter kills fewer of them.
translation: Tarajia wadudu waharibifu na ukungu kuongezeka; majira ya baridi yasiyo makali huua wachache tu.

english: Cold normally keeps pests and disease in check.
translation: Kwa kawaida baridi huzuia wadudu na magonjwa kuongezeka.

english: Choose crop varieties that ripen in a cooler, wetter summer.
translation: Chagua aina za mazao yanayokomaa katika majira ya joto yenye ubaridi na mvua zaidi.

english: Cool summers delay ripening and increase crop disease.
translation: Majira ya joto yenye ubaridi huchelewesha kukomaa na huongeza magonjwa ya mazao.

english: Follow your national weather service for warnings; this briefing is a seasonal outlook, not a warning.
translation: Fuata shirika la hali ya hewa la nchi yako ili kupata tahadhari; taarifa hii ni mwelekeo wa msimu, si tahadhari.

english: Only official services issue alerts for specific days and places.
translation: Mashirika rasmi tu hutoa tahadhari kwa siku na maeneo maalum.

english: Tell one neighbour what this season may bring.
translation: Mwambie jirani mmoja kile msimu huu unaweza kuleta.

english: Communities that talk about risk early prepare better.
translation: Jamii zinazozungumza kuhusu hatari mapema hujiandaa vizuri zaidi.

english: Coastal Peru and Ecuador
translation: Pwani ya Peru na Ekuado

english: Warm coastal water brings heavy rain to a normally dry coast. 1982-83, 1997-98 and 2017 brought severe floods.
translation: Maji ya joto ya pwani huleta mvua kubwa katika pwani ambayo kwa kawaida ni kavu. Miaka 1982-83, 1997-98 na 2017 ilileta mafuriko makubwa.

english: Cooler sea and drier coast.
translation: Bahari yenye ubaridi zaidi na pwani kavu zaidi.

english: Northern South America and the Amazon
translation: Kaskazini ya Amerika Kusini na Amazoni

english: Weaker rains and heat raise fire and river-low-water risk across the Orinoco and Amazon basins.
translation: Mvua hafifu na joto huongeza hatari ya moto na ya maji kupungua mitoni katika mabonde ya Orinoko na Amazoni.

english: Heavier rains, especially in Colombia and Venezuela.
translation: Mvua nyingi zaidi, hasa katika Kolombia na Venezuela.

english: Northeast Brazil (Nordeste)
translation: Kaskazini-mashariki ya Brazili (Nordeste)

english: The main rainy season often fails or comes late in strong El Niño years.
translation: Msimu mkuu wa mvua mara nyingi hushindikana au huchelewa katika miaka ya El Niño kali.

english: Rainy season tends to be stronger.
translation: Msimu wa mvua huelekea kuwa na mvua nyingi zaidi.

english: Southeastern South America
translation: Kusini-mashariki ya Amerika Kusini

english: Southern Brazil, Uruguay, northeastern Argentina and Paraguay usually get heavy spring and summer rain and river floods.
translation: Kusini ya Brazili, Uruguai, kaskazini-mashariki ya Ajentina na Paragwai kwa kawaida hupata mvua kubwa majira ya machipuko na majira ya joto, pamoja na mafuriko ya mito.

english: Drier spring and summer; crop stress is common.
translation: Majira ya machipuko na ya joto kavu zaidi; mazao hupata shida mara nyingi.

english: Central Chile
translation: Chile ya Kati

english: Winter storms tend to be wetter.
translation: Dhoruba za majira ya baridi huelekea kuwa na mvua nyingi zaidi.

english: Winter rains tend to be weak.
translation: Mvua za majira ya baridi huelekea kuwa hafifu.

english: Andean highlands (Altiplano)
translation: Nyanda za juu za Andes (Altiplano)

english: Summer rains tend to be weaker on the high plateau; the coast below can be wet at the same time.
translation: Mvua za majira ya joto huelekea kuwa hafifu katika uwanda wa juu; pwani iliyo chini inaweza kuwa na mvua kwa wakati huo huo.

english: Signal is weak and varies.
translation: Ishara ni hafifu na hubadilika.

english: Central America and southern Mexico
translation: Amerika ya Kati na kusini ya Meksiko

english: Rainy season starts late and the mid-summer dry spell (canícula) is longer, especially in the Dry Corridor.
translation: Msimu wa mvua huanza kwa kuchelewa na kipindi kikavu cha katikati ya majira ya joto (canícula) huwa kirefu zaidi, hasa katika Ukanda Mkavu.

english: More rain and a more active Atlantic hurricane season.
translation: Mvua nyingi zaidi na msimu wa vimbunga vya Atlantiki wenye shughuli nyingi zaidi.

english: Caribbean islands
translation: Visiwa vya Karibiani

english: Drier wet season and usually fewer Atlantic hurricanes.
translation: Msimu wa mvua ukavu zaidi na kwa kawaida vimbunga vichache vya Atlantiki.

english: More active Atlantic hurricane season.
translation: Msimu wa vimbunga vya Atlantiki wenye shughuli nyingi zaidi.

english: Southern United States and northern Mexico
translation: Kusini ya Marekani na kaskazini ya Meksiko

english: A stronger jet stream steers more winter storms across California, the Southwest, Texas, the Gulf coast and the Southeast.
translation: Mkondo wa hewa wa juu wenye nguvu zaidi huleta dhoruba nyingi za majira ya baridi katika California, Kusini-magharibi, Texas, pwani ya Ghuba na Kusini-mashariki.

english: Winter tends to be dry and warm across the southern states.
translation: Majira ya baridi huelekea kuwa makavu na yenye joto katika majimbo ya kusini.

english: Pacific Northwest and western Canada
translation: Kaskazini-magharibi ya Pasifiki na magharibi ya Kanada

english: Milder, drier winters and less mountain snow.
translation: Majira ya baridi yenye upole zaidi na ukavu, na theluji kidogo milimani.

english: Cooler, wetter winters with more snow.
translation: Majira ya baridi yenye ubaridi na mvua zaidi, na theluji nyingi zaidi.

english: Northern United States and southern Canada
translation: Kaskazini mwa Marekani na kusini mwa Kanada

english: Winters tend to be milder than usual across the northern Plains, Midwest and Great Lakes.
translation: Majira ya baridi huwa na baridi kidogo kuliko kawaida katika nyanda za kaskazini, Midwest na Maziwa Makuu.

english: Colder, snowier winters in the northern tier and Ohio Valley.
translation: Majira ya baridi yenye baridi zaidi na theluji nyingi zaidi katika ukanda wa kaskazini na Bonde la Ohio.

english: Alaska
translation: Alaska

english: Winters are usually much warmer than normal.
translation: Majira ya baridi kwa kawaida huwa na joto zaidi kuliko kawaida.

english: Colder winters.
translation: Majira ya baridi yenye baridi zaidi.

english: Hawaii
translation: Hawaii

english: Wet season is often weak; drought risk rises in late winter and spring.
translation: Msimu wa mvua mara nyingi huwa hafifu; hatari ya ukame huongezeka mwishoni mwa majira ya baridi na katika majira ya kuchipua.

english: Wetter winters.
translation: Majira ya baridi yenye mvua nyingi zaidi.

english: India, Pakistan, Nepal and Bangladesh (summer monsoon)
translation: India, Pakistan, Nepal na Bangladesh (monsuni ya majira ya joto)

english: The summer monsoon tends to be weaker and patchier. Not every El Niño brings drought, but the risk is clearly higher.
translation: Monsuni ya majira ya joto huelekea kuwa hafifu na mvua hunyesha kwa mabaka. Si kila El Niño huleta ukame, lakini hatari huwa kubwa zaidi.

english: Monsoon tends to be stronger with more floods.
translation: Monsuni huelekea kuwa na nguvu zaidi na mafuriko mengi zaidi.

english: Sri Lanka and southern India (northeast monsoon)
translation: Sri Lanka na kusini mwa India (monsuni ya kaskazini-mashariki)

english: The October-December rains tend to be heavier.
translation: Mvua za Okt–Des huelekea kuwa nyingi zaidi.

english: Weak signal.
translation: Ishara ni hafifu.

english: Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Brunei and Timor-Leste
translation: Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Brunei na Timor-Leste

english: The dry season is longer and harsher and the rainy season starts late. Forest and peat fires and smoke haze were severe in 1997 and 2015.
translation: Msimu wa kiangazi huwa mrefu na mkali zaidi, na msimu wa mvua huanza kwa kuchelewa. Moto wa misitu na wa ardhi ya mboji pamoja na moshi mzito ulikuwa mkubwa mwaka 1997 na 2015.

english: Wetter dry season and heavier rainy season.
translation: Msimu wa kiangazi wenye mvua zaidi na msimu wa mvua wenye mvua nyingi zaidi.

english: Philippines
translation: Ufilipino

english: Rain falls below normal from late in the year through the following dry season. Typhoons tend to form farther east and can be stronger.
translation: Mvua hunyesha chini ya kawaida kuanzia mwishoni wa mwaka hadi msimu wa kiangazi unaofuata. Vimbunga huelekea kutokea mbali zaidi upande wa mashariki na vinaweza kuwa na nguvu zaidi.

english: Wetter, with more typhoons crossing the islands.
translation: Mvua nyingi zaidi, na vimbunga vingi zaidi vinavyopita visiwani.

english: Vietnam, Thailand, Cambodia, Laos and Myanmar
translation: Vietnam, Thailand, Kambodia, Laos na Myanmar

english: Hotter, drier dry season; late monsoon onset; low Mekong flows and salt intrusion in the delta.
translation: Msimu wa kiangazi wenye joto na ukavu zaidi; monsuni huanza kwa kuchelewa; maji kidogo katika mto Mekong na maji ya chumvi huingia katika delta.

english: Wetter monsoon and more floods.
translation: Monsuni yenye mvua nyingi zaidi na mafuriko mengi zaidi.

english: Southern China and the Yangtze basin
translation: Kusini mwa China na bonde la Yangtze

english: Wetter winter and spring, and the summer after a strong El Niño often brings Yangtze flooding (1998, 2016).
translation: Majira ya baridi na ya machipuko yenye mvua nyingi zaidi, na majira ya joto yanayofuata El Niño yenye nguvu mara nyingi huleta mafuriko katika mto Yangtze (1998, 2016).

english: Colder, drier winters; signal is variable.
translation: Majira ya baridi yenye baridi zaidi na ukavu zaidi; ishara hubadilika mara kwa mara.

english: Northern China, Korea and Japan
translation: Kaskazini mwa China, Korea na Japani

english: Winters lean mild; summer signal is weak and mixed.
translation: Majira ya baridi huelekea kuwa na baridi kidogo; ishara ya majira ya joto ni hafifu na iliyochanganyika.

english: Winters lean cold.
translation: Majira ya baridi huelekea kuwa na baridi zaidi.

english: Papua New Guinea, Solomon Islands and Vanuatu
translation: Papua New Guinea, Visiwa vya Solomon na Vanuatu

english: Long dry spells; highland frost and crop loss in PNG in 1997 and 2015.
translation: Vipindi virefu vya ukavu; barafu ya baridi kali katika nyanda za juu na mazao yaliyoharibika nchini PNG mwaka 1997 na 2015.

english: Wetter, with cyclones more likely to the west.
translation: Mvua nyingi zaidi, na vimbunga vyenye uwezekano mkubwa upande wa magharibi.

english: Kiribati, Tuvalu, Nauru and the Marshall Islands
translation: Kiribati, Tuvalu, Nauru na Visiwa vya Marshall

english: Rain moves toward the central Pacific; equatorial atolls become much wetter, with higher sea levels in some areas.
translation: Mvua huhamia kuelekea Pasifiki ya kati; visiwa vya matumbawe vya ikweta huwa na mvua nyingi zaidi, na usawa wa bahari huwa juu zaidi katika maeneo mengine.

english: Severe drought on equatorial atolls.
translation: Ukame mkali katika visiwa vya matumbawe vya ikweta.

english: Fiji, Tonga, Samoa, Cook Islands and New Caledonia
translation: Fiji, Tonga, Samoa, Visiwa vya Cook na New Caledonia

english: The main rain band shifts northeast, so Fiji, Tonga and New Caledonia tend to be drier. Cyclones can reach farther east than usual.
translation: Ukanda mkuu wa mvua huhamia kaskazini-mashariki, kwa hiyo Fiji, Tonga na New Caledonia huelekea kuwa kavu zaidi. Vimbunga vinaweza kufika mashariki zaidi kuliko kawaida.

english: Wetter wet season.
translation: Msimu wa mvua wenye mvua nyingi zaidi.

english: Eastern and northern Australia
translation: Mashariki na kaskazini mwa Australia

english: Winter and spring rain is usually well below normal, with more heatwaves and bushfire risk; the northern wet season starts later.
translation: Mvua za majira ya baridi na ya machipuko kwa kawaida huwa chini sana ya kawaida, pamoja na vipindi vingi vya joto kali na hatari ya moto wa vichaka; msimu wa mvua wa kaskazini huanza kwa kuchelewa.

english: Wetter, with more floods and more tropical cyclones.
translation: Mvua nyingi zaidi, mafuriko mengi zaidi na vimbunga vingi zaidi vya tropiki.

english: Southwestern and southern Australia
translation: Kusini-magharibi na kusini mwa Australia

english: Signal is weaker than in the east.
translation: Ishara ni hafifu kuliko upande wa mashariki.

english: Weak signal.
translation: Ishara ni hafifu.

english: New Zealand
translation: New Zealand

english: Stronger westerly winds: drier in the northeast, wetter in the southwest, cooler overall.
translation: Pepo za magharibi zenye nguvu zaidi: kavu zaidi upande wa kaskazini-mashariki, mvua zaidi upande wa kusini-magharibi, na baridi kidogo kwa ujumla.

english: More northeasterly winds bring rain to the north and east.
translation: Pepo nyingi zaidi kutoka kaskazini-mashariki huleta mvua kaskazini na mashariki.

english: Kenya, Somalia, southern Ethiopia, Uganda and northern Tanzania
translation: Kenya, Somalia, kusini mwa Ethiopia, Uganda na kaskazini mwa Tanzania

english: The October-December short rains are usually heavy, with flooding along rivers and in low areas. 1997 and 2023 saw severe floods.
translation: Mvua za vuli (Okt–Des) kwa kawaida huwa nyingi, na huleta mafuriko kando ya mito na katika maeneo ya chini. Mwaka 1997 na mwaka 2023 kulikuwa na mafuriko makali.

english: Short rains fail more often; repeated La Niña years led to the 2020-23 Horn of Africa drought.
translation: Mvua za vuli hukosa kunyesha mara nyingi zaidi; miaka ya La Niña iliyofuatana ilisababisha ukame wa Pembe ya Afrika wa mwaka 2020–23.

english: Ethiopian highlands, Eritrea and Sudan (summer rains)
translation: Nyanda za juu za Ethiopia, Eritrea na Sudan (mvua za majira ya joto)

english: The main kiremt rains tend to be weaker; 2015 brought a severe drought in Ethiopia.
translation: Mvua kuu za kiremt huelekea kuwa hafifu zaidi; mwaka 2015 kulikuwa na ukame mkali nchini Ethiopia.

english: Weak tendency toward wetter summers.
translation: Mwelekeo hafifu wa majira ya joto yenye mvua nyingi zaidi.

english: Southern Africa
translation: Kusini mwa Afrika

english: Summer rains are usually below normal with hot spells; maize harvests failed widely in 1992, 2016 and 2024.
translation: Mvua za majira ya joto kwa kawaida huwa chini ya kawaida, pamoja na vipindi vya joto kali; mavuno ya mahindi yaliharibika katika maeneo mengi mwaka 1992, 2016 na 2024.

english: Wetter summers with more floods.
translation: Majira ya joto yenye mvua nyingi zaidi na mafuriko mengi zaidi.

english: Madagascar
translation: Madagaska

english: The south and west tend to be drier; cyclone activity shifts.
translation: Kusini na magharibi huelekea kuwa kavu zaidi; mwenendo wa vimbunga hubadilika.

english: Weak tendency toward wetter.
translation: Mwelekeo hafifu wa mvua nyingi zaidi.

english: The Sahel and northern Nigeria
translation: Sahel na kaskazini mwa Nigeria

english: Tendency toward a weaker rainy season, but Atlantic and Indian Ocean temperatures matter more here.
translation: Kuna mwelekeo wa msimu wa mvua kuwa dhaifu, lakini joto la Bahari ya Atlantiki na la Bahari ya Hindi lina athari kubwa zaidi hapa.

english: Weak tendency toward wetter.
translation: Mwelekeo dhaifu wa mvua kuwa nyingi zaidi.

english: West African coast (Gulf of Guinea)
translation: Pwani ya Afrika Magharibi (Ghuba ya Guinea)

english: No reliable rainfall signal; slightly warmer.
translation: Hakuna dalili ya kuaminika kuhusu mvua; joto huwa juu kidogo.

english: No reliable signal.
translation: Hakuna dalili ya kuaminika.

english: Central Africa (Congo basin)
translation: Afrika ya Kati (bonde la Kongo)

english: Weak rainfall signal; warmer than normal is common.
translation: Dalili ya mvua ni dhaifu; mara nyingi joto huwa juu ya kawaida.

english: No reliable signal.
translation: Hakuna dalili ya kuaminika.

english: Iran, Iraq, Afghanistan, northern Pakistan and the Arabian Peninsula
translation: Iran, Iraq, Afghanistan, kaskazini mwa Pakistan na Rasi ya Uarabuni

english: Winter and spring rains tend to be heavier, sometimes causing flash floods in dry areas.
translation: Mvua za majira ya baridi na za majira ya machipuko huwa nyingi zaidi. Wakati mwingine husababisha mafuriko ya ghafla katika maeneo makavu.

english: Winter rains and snow tend to be weak; drought risk rises.
translation: Mvua na theluji za majira ya baridi huwa chache; hatari ya ukame huongezeka.

english: Central Asia
translation: Asia ya Kati

english: Weak tendency toward wetter winters.
translation: Mwelekeo dhaifu wa majira ya baridi kuwa na mvua zaidi.

english: Weak tendency toward drier winters.
translation: Mwelekeo dhaifu wa majira ya baridi kuwa makavu zaidi.

english: North Africa and the Mediterranean
translation: Afrika Kaskazini na eneo la Bahari ya Mediterania

english: ENSO has little consistent effect here. Local forecasts matter more.
translation: ENSO haina athari ya uhakika hapa. Utabiri wa eneo lako una maana zaidi.

english: No reliable signal.
translation: Hakuna dalili ya kuaminika.

english: Europe
translation: Ulaya

english: Any effect is weak and inconsistent. Use your national forecast.
translation: Athari yoyote ni dhaifu na hubadilika badilika. Tumia utabiri wa nchi yako.

english: Weak, inconsistent effect.
translation: Athari ni dhaifu na hubadilika badilika.

english: Russia and Siberia
translation: Urusi na Siberia

english: No reliable signal.
translation: Hakuna dalili ya kuaminika.

english: No reliable signal.
translation: Hakuna dalili ya kuaminika.

english: Northern Canada and Greenland
translation: Kaskazini mwa Kanada na Greenland

english: Western and central Canada usually have milder winters.
translation: Kwa kawaida magharibi na katikati mwa Kanada huwa na majira ya baridi yasiyo makali sana.

english: Colder winters in western Canada.
translation: Majira ya baridi kali zaidi magharibi mwa Kanada.

english: Southeastern Brazil (São Paulo, Rio, Minas Gerais)
translation: Kusini-mashariki mwa Brazili (São Paulo, Rio, Minas Gerais)

english: Sits between the wet south and the dry north; rain signal is mixed, heat is more likely.
translation: Eneo hili liko kati ya kusini yenye mvua na kaskazini iliyo kavu; dalili ya mvua imechanganyika, lakini joto lina uwezekano mkubwa zaidi.

english: Mixed signal.
translation: Dalili imechanganyika.

english: US Southwest and northwestern Mexico
translation: Kusini-magharibi mwa Marekani na kaskazini-magharibi mwa Meksiko

english: Wetter winters across Arizona, New Mexico, Texas and northern Mexico.
translation: Majira ya baridi yenye mvua zaidi katika Arizona, New Mexico, Texas na kaskazini mwa Meksiko.

english: Dry, warm winters; drought risk rises.
translation: Majira ya baridi makavu na yenye joto; hatari ya ukame huongezeka.

english: Uruguay and the Pampas
translation: Uruguay na nyanda za Pampas

english: Spring rains are usually heavy.
translation: Kwa kawaida mvua za majira ya machipuko huwa nyingi.
